description: Fantasy game-world NFT collection on BNB Chain: 1,111 unique chibi-pixel Rifters across three factions (Riftwardens, Stormcallers, Voidborne), gated by Binance Agent ID (.ai). Two parallel lanes, both requiring a Binance Agent ID: a FREE lane (IDs 1-444, mintFree(), 0 BNB, max 3 per wallet, Common only) and a PAID lane (IDs 1001-1667, mintPaid(), exactly 0.001 BNB, max 5 per wallet, the only lane that can reveal Rare (167) and Legendary (33) Rifters). Paid holders unlock the Rift Shards game on the site, whose weekly leaderboard pays a 0.01 BNB prize pool to the top 3 players. Status: PRE-LAUNCH - the contract is not deployed yet; mint opens after the owner deploys. Machine-readable spec: llms.txt and mint.json on the official site.
name: Riftera
